verdict.rationale: Airweave syncs app and database data into searchable collections, mainly through vector search. Its agentic search mode can navigate entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling) and search iteratively, which gives some multi-hop, entity-aware retrieval. Nothing in the evidence shows a true knowledge graph of extracted entities and typed relationships, or a way to write agent memories into one. Missing for 10: knowledge-graph storage of entities and relationships, entity extraction, ways to write or store memories, graph traversal or query support beyond the source's own hierarchy, and independent corroboration.
